{
  "name": "server",
  "main": "src/index.ts",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsdown",
    "check-types": "tsc -b",
    "compile": "bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --bytecode ./src/index.ts --outfile server",
    "dev": "bun run --hot src/index.ts",
    "start": "bun run dist/index.js"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "dotenv": "catalog:",
    "zod": "catalog:",
    "@Social_Media_App/env": "workspace:*",

    "socket.io": "^4.8.3",
    "bullmq": "^5.80.8",

baselines.package.json:
{
  "name": "Social_Media_App",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": {
    "packages": [
      "apps/*",
      "packages/*"
    ],
    "catalog": {
      "dotenv": "^17.4.2",
      "zod": "^4.4.3",
      "@types/bun": "^1.3.14",
      "@ts-rest/core": "^3.52.1",
      "@reduxjs/toolkit": "^2.12.0",
      "@types/node": "^26.1.1",
      "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3",
      "@prisma/client": "^7.8.0"
    }
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "turbo dev",
    "build": "turbo build",
    "check-types": "turbo check-types",
    "dev:web": "turbo -F web dev",
    "dev:native": "turbo -F native dev",
    "dev:server": "turbo -F server dev",
    "db:push": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:push",
    "db:studio": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:studio",
    "db:generate": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:generate",
    "db:migrate": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:migrate",
    "db:start": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:start",
    "db:watch": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:watch",
    "db:stop": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:stop",
    "db:down": "turbo -F @Social_Media_App/db db:down",
    "lint:eslint": "eslint .",
    "format:prettier": "prettier --write .",
    "format:prettier:check": "prettier --check ."
  },
  "packageManager": "bun@1.3.5",
  "dependencies": {
    "dotenv": "catalog:",
    "zod": "catalog:",
    "@Social_Media_App/env": "workspace:*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "@types/bun": "catalog:",
    "@Social_Media_App/config": "workspace:*",
    "turbo": "^2.10.0",
    "eslint": "^10.7.0",
    "@eslint/js": "^10.0.1",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.64.0",
    "globals": "^17.7.0",
    "prettier": "^3.9.5"
  }
}
